request: House Rivalry, Banter and Victory Traditions

continuity_review.method: Manual review of revised scenes, surrounding scene context, character dossiers, bottle lore and complete repository diff
continuity_review.result: Preserved scene identities, established mission outcomes, ranks, identities and relationships; additions develop dialogue, culture and minor personal history.
specific_checks: Dennis remains Joel’s veteran friend; no inherited bloodline tolerance assigned.
Eastern wager is separate from the existing southern and western reserves.
Daniel joins the cruiser wager; Anton transfers ownership while contesting its interpretation.
Dennis retains the existing Gatehold win; receipt remains separate from opening.
Existing casualty sequences and recovery priorities remain intact.
New celebrations and wagers preserve command, triage, serving and guest boundaries.

changed_scenes.title: Full Combat Load
improvements: Joel makes a calculated private wager while both brothers respect Mara’s command and system restrictions.

changed_scenes.title: First to the Bridge
improvements: An experienced Grey Nomad wins bragging rights through surrender and immediately returns to casualty work.

changed_scenes.title: Race to the Bridge
improvements: Define a clean-capture wager under the captain’s objectives, with Christer as witness and Daniel as the quiet tactical competitor.
Show Daniel enforcing the assigned mission and prisoner security before the tactical contest.
Establish a specific disputed eastern-bottle debt without changing the cruiser capture or its rival claims.

changed_scenes.title: The Fleet Comes for Central
improvements: Give Banner-Captain Rydell a long rivalry with Joel and show veteran preparation before junior boasting.

changed_scenes.title: The Maniacs of the Grey Nomad
improvements: Keep the Grey Nomads human and rowdy while a medic redirects counting into disciplined rescue work.
Confirm the existing Primarch-reserve offer and extend bottle debts to the older generation regardless of rank.
Bind the existing prize pool to orders, triage and shared small-serving hospitality for ordinary House troops.

changed_scenes.title: Dennis Has Arrived
improvements: Dennis makes a blunt hunter challenge bounded by Daniel’s engineering needs, with a modest personal stake.

changed_scenes.title: Elder Bjorn’s Bottle
improvements: Keep the command-ship competition within the established carrier captain’s safe approach and friendly-fire boundaries.

changed_scenes.title: House Victory
improvements: Preserve Dennis’s existing win and make the High Marshal acknowledge a personal, irreplaceable bottle debt.

changed_scenes.title: What Victory Leaves Behind
improvements: Let an old debt become remembrance without making grief another punchline.
Pay Dennis’s established debt with Lars enforcing it; keep the bottle sealed while survivors remain in surgery or recovery.

changed_scenes.title: The Open March
improvements: Add a post-recovery victory feast with veteran wit, a decades-old debt, rare Reserve, hospitality limits and remembrance.

changed_scenes.title: The Rust Bucket
improvements: Carry the cruiser’s disputed eastern-bottle debt into an engineering contest verified by independent mechanics.
Settle the running bottle debt while Anton preserves his bragging-rights dispute; keep the refit certification intact.

changed_scenes.title: Boarding the Beast
improvements: Use an old cruiser argument as a brief pre-breach challenge that ends with shared tactical preparation.

changed_scenes.title: Feast Before the Spear
improvements: Apply established small-serving, guest and duty rules to the war-feast without inventing shared bloodline tolerance.
Show inherited admiral betting pools, precise bottle stakes and a callback to Anton’s paid debt.
Make Charter obligations and casualty review govern wagers, without treating people as owned categories.
Let an allied commander decline Reserve without a challenge or loss of standing.

changed_scenes.title: The Wardens of Vintergard
improvements: Distinguish Joel’s paid Bjorn-made bottle from Bjorn’s own stock and let an elder challenge the veteran Hunter.

changed_scenes.title: The Living First
improvements: Keep the Ghar-Kul result unresolved while promising a future table; warmth follows the elder’s recovery rather than interrupting remembrance.

changed_scenes.title: The Work That Waited
improvements: Carry brotherly rivalry into the Warden repair bay while respecting Bjorn’s continuing medical limits.

changed_scenes.title: The Exorcists Enter the Grave
improvements: Extend competitive culture to senior engineers and an escort admiral, with a disputed technical wager and no invented salvage outcome.

changed_scenes.title: When the Primarch Arrived
improvements: Give Lars a decisive one-liner that humbles Anton and reinforces the existing no-pursuit order and veteran command skill.
